name: ISO/IEC 27018:2019
description: Code of practice for protection of personally identifiable information (PII) in public clouds acting as PII processors. Extension of ISO 27001/27002 for PII in cloud.

controls.title: Consent and choice
controls.description: Except as permitted by applicable law, the public cloud PII processor shall only process PII in accordance with instructions provided by the PII controller.

controls.title: Purpose legitimacy and specification
controls.description: The public cloud PII processor shall process PII only for the purposes specified in the contract with the PII controller, not for any other purpose including its own purposes.

controls.title: Collection limitation
controls.description: The public cloud PII processor shall only collect PII to the extent necessary to provide the specified service.

controls.title: Use, retention and disclosure limitation
controls.description: The public cloud PII processor shall retain, use, and disclose PII only to the extent necessary and for the purposes specified in the contract.

controls.title: Accountability
controls.description: The public cloud PII processor shall make available information necessary for PII principals to exercise their rights.

controls.title: Information security
controls.description: The public cloud PII processor shall implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect PII against accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorized disclosure.

controls.title: Privacy breach notification
controls.description: The public cloud PII processor shall notify the PII controller without undue delay after becoming aware of a breach of security leading to accidental or unlawful destruction of PII.

controls.title: Sub-processors and sub-contracting
controls.description: The public cloud PII processor shall inform the PII controller of any sub-processors it engages to process PII and ensure sub-processors provide the same level of PII protection.
